_note: Every body here was recorded by pointing a client's base URL at a local 127.0.0.1 listener that answered 400; no real API was contacted. Prose is replaced by "x" in the Claude Code and Codex bodies (every key kept); the SDK bodies are verbatim. Dates are the capture day.

claude_code_messages_main.json.how: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL at the listener, `claude -p`, one turn

claude_code_messages_full_tools.json.how: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL at the listener, `claude -p`, the request that carried the full tool list

codex_responses_exec.json.how: a model_providers entry whose base_url is the listener, `codex exec`, default tools (web_search on)

openai_sdk_chat_stream_tools.json.client: openai Python SDK (the SDK's own wire shape, not an agent client)
openai_sdk_chat_stream_tools.json.how: pip --target into a scratch directory, `chat.completions.create` with a function tool and stream on, base_url the listener; the SDK added no field beyond those passed

openai_sdk_chat_openrouter_path.json.client: openai Python SDK (the SDK's own wire shape, not an agent client)
openai_sdk_chat_openrouter_path.json.how: base_url `<listener>/api/v1` (an OpenRouter-style path), OpenRouter's HTTP-Referer and X-Title as default headers (headers are not in the body), `provider` through extra_body

openai_sdk_responses_stream_tools.json.client: openai Python SDK (the SDK's own wire shape, not an agent client)
openai_sdk_responses_stream_tools.json.how: `responses.create` with a function tool and stream on, base_url the listener
